boundary: This is a design decision map. It records runtime interaction behavior to preserve in Sites without wiring Shopper SSR, Tools, Woo, payment, or production services.

surfaces.decision: Preserve the interaction job—product selection, focusable controls, image priority and reduced motion—while keeping the newer LockedHero visual hierarchy. Do not copy runtime styling wholesale.

runtimeReferences: apps/olympus-shopper-ui/src/App.tsx product route and OpenLab route branches
surfaces.decision: Preserve selectable record, label-comparison and source-context views; recompose their material, hierarchy and controls in the Sites system. The content compiler deepens charts, report views and dossier comparisons from OpenLabPublicProjection.v2 without blocking design work on runtime projection availability.

decisionProcess: Inspect the current shopper implementation read-only.
Describe the customer interaction job independently of its old visual form.
Implement the job against the Sites tokens and components.
Prove keyboard, reduced-motion, 1440 and 390 behavior in Sites.
Nativeise the accepted Sites composition in Figma as an editable inspection mirror.
Only then consider Shopper SSR adaptation under its separate runtime gate.
